text:
olivia: Heads-up — Pinnacle shipped an RFI this AM. They want (1) a capability matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private, (2) completed security questionnaire, and (3) a 2-week POC plan + costs. Deadline: Friday COB. I uploaded a starter folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PinnacleRFI (drive link, view only).

sanjay: Thanks. Do we know target latency/throughput for the POC? Are they testing generation or embeddings?

michelle: Their RFI says low-latency chat + high throughput embeddings. Quote: "~100 qps embeddings, 50k tokens/day gen". They also mention wanting on-prem option for compliance.

elaine: Security Q highlights: KMS/HSM support, customer-managed keys, logs retention, SOC2/FedRAMP posture, egress controls. I'll take the questionnaire. Please tag any answers that need legal sign-off.

marco: For pricing, suggest we propose: Dedicated baseline (4x A100 equiv) + burst pool; include a hosted trial estimate for the eval (14 days, limited tokens). I'll draft numbers after we confirm POC scope.

olivia: Action items: (a) SRE/infra to fill capabilities matrix rows about autoscale, burst, and regional failover (sanjay), (b) Security to own questionnaire (elaine), (c) Pricing + contract leads (marco), (d) POC runbook + metrics (michelle). Can everyone ack?

sanjay: ack. I'll start the matrix. Proposed columns: Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Sample rows: model catalog, quantization options, KV cache, autoscale latency SLO, isolation, KMS integration, audit logs, support SLAs.

sanjay: matrix template ->
```
Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes
--------|--------|-----------|--------|------
Model catalog | Yes (curated) | Yes | Yes | list variants available
Quantization | Optimized paths | Customer-controlled | Depends on infra | detail quant bits
KV cache | Global prefix caching | Dedicated KV cache | customer-managed cache | perf delta
Autoscale | region-based autoscale | pool + burst | by-deployment autoscale | SLA impact
```

michelle: For the POC runbook, include these checkpoints: baseline latency (p50/p95), token cost, accuracy regressions on our eval set, failover test, and data residency verification. I'll draft a 2-week timeline: week1 ingest + baseline, week2 load test + validation + handoff.

elaine: I'll start the security spreadsheet. Quick note: for HSM answers — we need to confirm HSM vendor integrations and whether customers can bring their own HSM. @olivia add that as a clarifying Q.

olivia: Added to the Drive doc: "Q: Do you require BYO-HSM or is customer-managed KMS sufficient?" Also asked whether they need red-team signing or just SOC2 attestation.

rfi-bot: Document created: /Pinnacle/RFI/initial-packet.pdf (uploaded by olivia)

marco: Pricing draft idea: offer two POC tiers — (1) Hosted eval: free credits for 14 days (rate-limited), (2) Dedicated POC: $X/day flat for reserved nodes + per-token overage. Include optional private deployment setup fee. I'll add a sample cost table in the Drive.

olivia: Let's do a quick sync at 3pm to walk through the matrix and security answers before we send. Can people make that?

michelle: 3pm works for me. I'll bring the runbook draft.

elaine: OK for 3. I'll add risky questions that need legal.

sanjay: Got it. I'll have a first-pass capability matrix by 1pm so we can review.

marco: acked. I'll have preliminary pricing ranges by 2pm.

olivia: Perfect — thanks team. We need a clean package by EOD Thursday to iterate with legal on Friday.

sanjay: one more note — Pinnacle asked for sample performance numbers for 2k token context. I'll paste benchmark snippets into the Drive.

michelle: Example snippet for the RFI (putting here so it gets tracked):
```
P50 latency (2k tokens) - Hosted: 220ms
P95 latency (2k tokens) - Dedicated (4x GPUs): 540ms
Embedding throughput - 100 qps sustained on Dedicated pool with batching
```

olivia: Thanks — this thread is our source of truth. I'll compile and push the finalized package to the folder and post back the outgoing PDF for sign-off. :thumbsup:
